// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// @expect: OPS-IMPORT-ALLOWLIST
// One allowlist entry is one allowlist entry. @/lib/billing.ts is a plausible
// shared billing helper with a plausible reason to be reached from a billing
// screen, and it is still denied: it holds freezeSubscription() and the
// governing-subscription resolution, which are writes and reads over the live
// tables. Ops reaches data through src/lib/ops/reads.ts and nowhere else.
import "server-only";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { governingSubscription } from "@/lib/billing";

export async function billingForSchool(schoolId) {
  const school = await db.school.findUnique({
    where: { id: schoolId },
    select: { id: true, name: true },
  });
  return { school, sub: await governingSubscription(schoolId) };
}
